text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-3440/254-US32D Stainless Steel Contemporary Flush Door Pull.

This very contemporary Stainless Steel Flush Pull was Designed and manufactured by First Impressions just for us. First Impressions offers some of the most diverse and beautiful styles door pulls we carry. Made in the USA.

Concealed mounting screws for a very clean look. Make an up-to-date decor statement with these designer choice contemporary flush door pulls!

This large Contemporary Style flush door pull can be used in many applications such as:

  • Sliding and Pocket Doors
  • Metal framed glass doors, such as on Showers
  • Just about anywhere a Flush with the Door face door pull is needed.

Specifications for First Impressions FII-3440/254 Contemporary Flush Door Pull

  • Total Length: 10" (254 mm)
  • Total Width: 2-3/4"
  • Max Depth : 7/8"
  • Face Plate Thickness: 1/4"
  • Opening Length: 4-3/4"
  • Opening Width: 1-5/8"
  • Face Material: Stainless Steel
  • Packaged Complete with Mounting Hardware
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Sold individually.



** This item is discontinued
